Ṛṣi
--Camatkāracintāmaṇi. jy. Nepal I. p.. 169-70. While some mss. of the work mention no a., in others a. is found a. Rājarṣi Bhaṭṭa or Nārāyaṇa. C.. Ṛṣiśarman, Jñānamañjarī.

Ṛṣi
I of the Payyūr Bhaṭṭa line of Porkalam in Kerala who specialised in the works of Maṇḍana; brother of Bhavadāsa I; wife, Gaurī; father of Parameśvara I (Haricarita, C. Sumanoramaṇī on Meghadūta, C.s on Nyāyakaṇikā, etc.). Beg. of the 14th cent. A. D.
Ṛṣi. ref. to by Udaya in his C. on Kauṣ. Brāhmaṇa (Adyar D.
) is one of these Ṛṣis, I, II or III.

Ṛṣi
II grandson of Ṛṣi I an. son of Parameśvara I; wife, Gopālikā; eldest of five brothers, Bhavadāsa II, Vāsudeva I etc.; father of Parameśvara II (C.s on Sphoṭasiddhi, Tattvabindu etc.) an. Vāsudeva II (Devīcarita an. other Yamaka poems).

Ṛṣi
III also known a. Traividyeśa an. Maharṣi, son of Parameśvara II; wife, Āryā; father of Parameśvara III (Jaiminīyasūtrārthasaṁgraha). Mid. of the 15th cent. A. D. Ref. to by Uddaṇḍa [Page039-b] in Mallikāmāruta. See Poona Ori. XXII, p.. 52-57.
